source_path: Floom original, written 2026-11-01 from the post-signal steps Federico De Ponte's content workflow runs: his own post stats, saved reference posts ranked by engagement, the free fxtwitter API for X posts, scheduler analytics, and pay-per-call scrapers only as the paid option.
note: The method is Federico De Ponte's: rank posts by engagement per view with medians and n, borrow the shape of reference posts that performed and never their words, cite the reference post and its number with every idea. Scripts written by Claude Opus 5.5 in Claude Code. signals.py is standard library only and makes no network call. fxtwitter.py calls only the public read endpoint api.fxtwitter.com/status/<id>, with no key. No post data, private accounts, names or paths are included. Not affiliated with X Corp or fxtwitter.
